proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Lobbying Report
proposals.proponent: Zevin Asset Management, on behalf of William Creighton, and co-filers Benedictine Sisters of Virginia, Congregation of Divine Providence Trust, Dana Investment Advisors, Dominican Sisters of Springfield, IL, First Affirmative Financial Network, LLC for Jane M. Ritchie Trust, Miller/Howard for Michael Roomberg, and Providence Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing AbbVie's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association model-legislation memberships, and board oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that you vote "AGAINST" the proposals for the reasons set forth following the proposals.*

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Independent Chair
proposals.proponent: The Employees' Retirement System of Rhode Island and co-filers Common Spirit Health and Vermont Pension Investment Committee
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board adopt a policy and amend bylaws so the Chair of the Board is, whenever possible, an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
